name: @openhax/openplanner
description: API-first personal data lake for LLM session archives with DuckDB (FTS) + ChromaDB (vectors).

scripts.build:recall: pnpm --filter @open-hax/openplanner-store-cache build && pnpm --filter @open-hax/openplanner-document-hydration build && pnpm --filter @open-hax/openplanner-sdk build && pnpm --filter @open-hax/openplanner-graph-claim-core build
scripts.test:recall: pnpm --filter @open-hax/openplanner-graph-claim-core test && pnpm --filter @open-hax/openplanner-graph-claim-core exec node scripts/verify-recall-test-exit.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && c8 --reporter=text --reporter=lcov --reporter=html node --test dist/tests/*.test.js
